post.title: The country whose lowest point beats Britain's highest mountain ⛰️
post.premise: There is a country where the lowest spot is higher than Britain's highest mountain
post.bait: Could you live 1.4 km up, minimum? 👇
post.description:
There is a kingdom in southern Africa where you cannot get anywhere near sea level: its lowest river junction is higher than the summit of Ben Nevis. This map story finds that lowest point, climbs to the highest, and pulls back to show the whole country sealed inside its only neighbour.
Could you live 1.4 km up, minimum? Tell us below.
